prior_review_decision: REJECT (PR #5698 exact head ddae71d1ce4d48fbfdc3e5818eebefcb1f0c06b6, manifest blob c3ec1a844796de1566ad4c76959730f00ed57cff): (P1) main.py built observations before tenant filtering and service.py selected the first global record's provenance, so a tenant-a context could carry tenant-b owner/source_version/correlation_id even at runtime_count=0. (P1) service.py's get_context_telemetry_summary overwrote successful telemetry backfill/replay provenance with owner=runtime_id, source_kind=live, source_version/correlation_id=None, observed_at=now, freshness=0. (P1) service.py probed domain surface status separately before the actual list read; a provider that answered the probe successfully and then failed on the real read (error swallowed inside the port) was reported as an empty ok/live row instead of failing closed. (P1) main.py ignored non-telemetry owner failures when aggregating portfolio_book/persona_fleet status (e.g. runtime owner raising while pools/personas existed still reported status=ok).
normative_plan: SD sec7 ManagementObservation row shape and Management AI product/development boundary, SA invariants 11-12 and ADR-01/ADR-08; pkt-pantheon-structural-closure-functional-v2-20260903

implementation.summary: Management AI context collection (_mgmt_nl_collect_context in main.py) previously reached the Management domain by calling the module-global ReadSurfacePorts object (read_store.list_runtime_bindings/list_capital_pools/list_incidents/list_evolution_decisions/get_telemetry_summary) directly -- generic store access bypassing the purpose-built ManagementService. Replaced every such call with new purpose-built ManagementService context accessors (get_context_runtime_bindings, get_context_capital_pools, get_context_incidents, get_context_evolution_decisions, get_context_telemetry_summary), instantiated once as module-level _management_ai_context_service bound to the same app_deps.read_surface used by the Management read-model routers. Each accessor returns (items, ManagementObservation) instead of a bare list: an unavailable or failing domain now returns an explicit typed degraded row (source_kind=unavailable, degradation_reason set) rather than an ad hoc {"status": "unavailable"} dict or a silently empty list, and the row is threaded into the NL context surfaces payload (owner_observation / owner_observations) so unavailable owners are never silently omitted.
implementation.post_reject_fix_summary: Addressed the three P1 defects from the first independent reject: (1) _typed_context_list now resolves each subject's real domain surface status via ReadSurfacePorts.get_surface_status() (persona_capital_runtime.runtime/capital/evolution.surfaces.evolution_decisions) before trusting a non-raising empty list; an unconfigured/provider-failed owner is reported status=unavailable even though the underlying port call itself did not raise (subjects with no such upstream signal, e.g. incidents, keep the prior try/except-based inference, documented in _DOMAIN_SURFACE_STATUS_PATH). (2) _context_observation is now built through the previously-unused ManagementObservation pydantic model (model_dump()) instead of a hand-rolled dict, and _typed_context_list inspects returned records for real owner/source_kind/source_version/observed_at/correlation_id provenance (via _record_provenance) and preserves it verbatim -- including computing freshness_seconds from the real observed_at instead of always stamping now()/freshness=0 or promoting replay/backfill to live. (3) get_context_telemetry_summary now returns (summary, ManagementObservation) instead of swallowing exceptions into None; _mgmt_nl_collect_context's portfolio branch aggregates every telemetry observation into owner_observations and sets portfolio_book status=degraded whenever any telemetry read failed, instead of staying ok solely because pools/runtime bindings existed.
implementation.second_post_reject_fix_summary: Addressed the four P1 defects from the second independent reject: (1) _typed_context_list now accepts an optional record_filter callable; _mgmt_nl_collect_context passes a tenant-scoping filter (built from the existing _mgmt_nl_filter_tenant_records) into every get_context_runtime_bindings/get_context_capital_pools/get_context_incidents/get_context_evolution_decisions call across the cockpit, trading_pulse, portfolio, and persona_fleet branches, so unauthorized-tenant records are dropped before _record_provenance ever inspects them -- a tenant-a call can no longer surface a tenant-b owner/source_version/correlation_id even when its own scoped record count is zero. (2) get_context_telemetry_summary now runs the same _record_provenance derivation used for list-shaped subjects against the returned summary dict and preserves its real owner/source_kind/source_version/observed_at/correlation_id instead of always stamping runtime_id/live/now/freshness=0. (3) _typed_context_list no longer trusts a pre-read domain_status probe to justify status=ok when the actual read comes back empty (a flaky/failing provider can answer the probe successfully and then fail on the real read, with the port swallowing the error into an empty list); status is now derived from the real read outcome -- non-empty is ok, empty fails closed to unavailable (domain_status said so) or degraded (ambiguous/no signal). (4) main.py's portfolio_book and persona_fleet status now aggregate every contributing owner_observation status (pools/runtime/telemetry for portfolio; runtime/incidents/evolution_decisions for persona_fleet) instead of only checking telemetry or record presence, so a runtime-owner failure can no longer be masked by a coexisting pool/persona success.
implementation.row_shape_added: ManagementObservation pydantic model added to management_read_models/models.py (subject_type, subject_id, status, owner, source_kind: live|replayed|backfill|unavailable, source_version, observed_at, freshness_seconds, degradation_reason, correlation_id) per SD sec7.1; now constructed directly by service.py instead of being unused.

mandatory_deletions.generic_store_access_in_management_ai_co: _mgmt_nl_collect_context in main.py no longer calls the bare module-global read_store.* surface; it exclusively calls the new typed ManagementService context accessors, matching how the Management read-model router already reaches the domain through ManagementService.
mandatory_deletions.seed_task_status_product_truth: Verified absent from the declared MGMT-READ-001 scope prior to this change (no ai-status.json / seed / task-status reads in services/control-plane/bff/management_read_models or services/control-plane/bff/main.py Management AI path); confirmed still absent after this change.
mandatory_deletions.development_task_authority_from_manageme: Verified unchanged: _mgmt_nl_reject_development_payload continues to reject repair/task-shaped payloads before context collection, and test_management_nl_context_pack_excludes_development_orchestrator_status continues to assert orchestrator/task state never enters the context pack.

implementation.rollback_plan: Revert the modified files; _mgmt_nl_collect_context reverts to direct read_store access and the ManagementService context accessors/ManagementObservation model return to their prior (rejected) unavailable-inference and provenance-erasing behavior. No data migration or persisted state is introduced by this change; rollback must not resurrect seed/synthetic data for unavailable owners.
